title: HunFlair2 in a cross-corpus evaluation of biomedical named entity recognition and normalization tools

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting cross-corpus evaluations by applying named entity recognition and normalization tools to out-of-domain text collections to measure performance degradation caused by overfitting to the specific concept definitions, text types, and annotation guidelines of their training corpora.

Comparing macro F1 scores to micro F1 scores to analyze whether high overall performance is disproportionately driven by accurately identifying a few highly frequent biomedical entities (e.g., cancer or mice) while failing on rare, long-tail concepts.
